description: Original data of PV power prediction is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Ruoyang Zhang. The dataset includes observed photovoltaic power generation data from relevant photovoltaic power studies, along with meteorological parameters. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 763171 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
